title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: plasterboard and ceilings

swms.title: Plasterboard walls
swms.task: Fix plasterboard sheets to the apartment walls, moving sheets to each floor by hoist.

swms.title: Suspended ceilings and bulkheads
swms.task: Install suspended ceiling grids and fix plasterboard ceiling sheets in the apartments and corridors, using sheet lifters and mobile scaffolds.

steps: Fix ceilings and bulkheads at height

swms.title: Setting and sanding
swms.task: Set and sand the plasterboard joints and cornices in the apartments.
